saw_lines: Electrical buyers match what is already on the wall, so they buy a socket once and return only for a renovation.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a buyer decides in seconds whether this fits their wall.
Your 5 of 14 copy ads run the same text, so keep that copy and change the opening line and creative in each ad.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: One exact copy runs in 5 of 14 ads, so a buyer who already scrolled past it meets the same first line again. Keep the body text, rewrite the opening line and swap the creative in each of those 5 ads.

None of your 14 written ads shows a proof number, so a new buyer has nothing concrete to trust before the click. Collect one figure, a review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it on the creative.

5 of 14 copy ads open on the same “Uppgradera med stil” line, while the rest are single use, so the account leans on one pitch. Test two new angles against that opener, price and fast delivery, in three ads each.
8 of your 15 Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, so they have to search again. Point each of those 8 to the product or category its creative shows, such as the switches and sockets page.

ads_1: Switch and socket ads with new openers, each leading with a proof figure
